rationale: The workflow runs daily on a schedule and can also be triggered manually. Adding concurrency control with `cancel-in-progress: true` implements the P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE pattern (cancel superseded runs). This prevents multiple queued runs of the same workflow on the same branch, which can occur if a scheduled run is delayed or a manual dispatch coincides with a scheduled run. The preconditions are met: runs represent the same workflow and branch, and a newer scheduled run supersedes an older one. Contraindications do not apply (not a release/deployment workflow, and the concurrency group includes the ref to isolate branches). The pattern reports 1.9% free and 4.1% paid VM time reduction from canceling superseded runs. The change is minimal, preserves all build/test coverage, and adds no new permissions or network access.
